a.lede: Teenage Engineering announced what it describes as "a modern take on a classic CD player" with its new EP/BC-1 featuring a slab-like design that leaves the spinning disc exposed instead of hiding it under a lid or inside a slide-out tray. The company says the EP/BC-1 is the first entry in its new broadcast series […]
a.title: Teenage Engineering’s first CD player puts the spinning disc on display

b.lede: The EP/BC-1 costs $329 and marks the start of a new line of "broadcast" audio equipment.
b.title: Teenage Engineering's first CD player kind of looks like a turntable
